proof_body:
by
  intro f m hf hm hb z w
  have hne : ∀ x, f x ≠ 0 := fun x h0 => by
    have := hb x
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hg : Differentiable ℂ (fun x => (f x)⁻¹) := hf.inv hne
  have hbd : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range (fun x => (f x)⁻¹)) := by
    refine isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr ⟨m⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [norm_inv]
    exact inv_anti₀ hm (hb x)
  exact inv_injective (hg.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded hbd z w)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (m : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ f → 0 < m → (∀ z, m ≤ ‖f z‖) → ∀ z w, f z = f w
